- [LLEX.12.1.1] **Scientific literals are a distinct token class**
  (LUNI.3.1.5). `1e6` (`FLOAT_LIT` scientific) keeps its spelling, and
  the unit `_` ([LLEX.12.1]) never stands inside it: a `_` within it is a digit
  group separator, between two digits of its mantissa or of its exponent as
  [LLEX.11.2] places it (`1e1_0` = `1e10`); resolution order is §LLEX.11.3.1. Because the `_` is
  **optional** ([LLEX.12.1]), it cannot be what marks a unit, so the
  reservation of `i`/`j`/`e`/`E` as non-unit-names and the `e<digit>`
  shadow exclusion are **load-bearing, not guards** — they are the only
  thing that lets `1e6` reach `FLOAT_LIT` at all ([LLEX.11.3.1]).
  `COMPLEX_LIT` is not a v1 token class ([LUNI.14]), so `5i` is refused
  ([LUNI.14.9]) and `5_i` reaches no token class. A scientific prefix on a unit
  may take the `_`: `1e6_s`, `1.0e3_ms`.
